        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

os.makedirs(p,exist_ok=True)
prog='''def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r in range(H):
        row=g[r]
        other=[c for c in range(W) if row[c]!=bgc]
        if not other or len(other)==W: continue
        if other==list(range(other[0],other[-1]+1)):
            lg=other[0]>0; rg=other[-1]<W-1
            if rg and (not lg or other[0]>W-1-other[-1]):
                for c in range(other[-1]+1,W): row[c]=1
            elif lg:
                for c in range(0,other[0]): row[c]=1
    return g
'''
open(p+'/task-bb12a4f7.py','w').write(prog)
